title: A Cold and Rainy Walk
text:
Today is cold and windy. Ben puts on a warm coat, a hat and gloves. He wears his blue scarf too. Then he goes out to the park.

In the park, the sky is grey and it starts to rain. Ben opens his red umbrella. His shoes are wet, but his coat keeps him warm. Ben likes rainy days.

questions.text: What does Ben wear on his head?
Why does Ben put on a warm coat?
options: Because it is cold and windy
Because it is hot and sunny
Because he is going to swim
Because he wants a new coat

questions.text: How does Ben probably feel when it rains in the park?

vocabulary.definition: a long piece of cloth worn around the neck to keep warm
a device you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain
when there is a lot of wind outside

paragraph_translations: Dzisiaj jest zimno i wietrznie. Ben zakłada ciepły płaszcz, czapkę i rękawiczki. Zakłada też swój niebieski szalik. Potem wychodzi do parku.
W parku niebo jest szare i zaczyna padać deszcz. Ben otwiera swój czerwony parasol. Jego buty są mokre, ale płaszcz utrzymuje go w cieple. Ben lubi deszczowe dni.
